title: Vesper and the Horizon
author: Lior Lockridge
blurb: Wren Delacroix, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
